gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participant must have a diagnosis of high grade (WHO Grade III or IV) glioma following brain surgery to proceed with study treatment.

candidate_evidence.quote: evaluate any preliminary evidence of anticancer activity of pembrolizumab combined with either pemetrexed or abemaciclib

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with newly diagnosed high grade glioma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Measure the amount of pembrolizumab, pemetrexed, and/or abemaciclib that gets in the body by collecting blood and cerebrospinal fluid.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Comparison of genetic analysis of tumor tissue collected before and after study treatment.

coder_notes: Population is high-grade (WHO grade III or IV) glioma; glioblastoma is not named. Registry phase EARLY_PHASE1. Supportive medications (ibuprofen, folic acid, vitamin B12, dexamethasone) appear only within the pemetrexed description and are not listed. Target engagement coded unclear: paired pre/post tumour tissue genetic analysis is planned but not stated as pharmacodynamic for a candidate. Tumour PK coded yes because CSF drug levels are planned. Keywords mention CDK4/CDK6 but no biomarker is required.
